summary: {reader} tests a proposed hearing-aid label against the experience of asking someone to repeat a sentence.
realLife: A commenter used soft voices and missed consonants to explain why a customer might recognize a listening problem in familiar situations. FDA used listening examples in its labeling.
inGame: needs: packaging examples and a constituent account.

turns.pulledBy: A reader recognizes the situation described on the box.
turns.what: A reader tests the description against a recent conversation.
turns.writesBack: The member can explain how a shopper uses the example.

turns.pulledBy: The example leaves a reader unsure about their needs.
turns.what: The reader cannot place their experience in either example.
turns.writesBack: A constituent brings the unanswered question to a hearing professional.
